commenti.body:
Just a 10/10 film. Shaffer deserves a ton of credit for giving Forman so much of the framework. Forman & Abraham’s ability to put the audience inside of Salieri is a level of empathy I’ve never seen duplicated. The Requiem scene is magical. Salieri realizes his hands are literally dictating to paper the mind God. He can’t make himself resist this role though his role is a source of anger due to his envy.

https://youtu.be/USe-wZ0AOQQ?si=xa831zfaVZaeK98m
Yes, there are a lot of scenes I could have called my favorite. I also have a favorite line that I still use all the time - "Too many notes."
